supplemental_limit: The grounded shoe toe meets/crosses the lower frame edge. This is a prompt-framing imperfection. It does not remove the declared floor-support/contact evidence, and no new full-toe gate is added after pixels. No blanket claim of exact full-prompt fidelity.
